author: KrustyKrew
name: DeadByDaylight
short: Shrine of Secrets, full random loadouts, perk/item/add-on/offering lookups and a Prestige 100 tracker.
description: Dead by Daylight for every platform (no accounts needed). Weekly Shrine of Secrets posts with perk wishlist pings, full random loadouts (character, perks, item or power with matching add-ons, offering) for you or your whole voice channel, lookups for perks, characters, items, add-ons and offerings, add-on galleries per killer or item, and a Prestige 100 tracker. Uses official icons exported with FModel when present (Icons/ folder), with drawn fallbacks. Game data from dbd.tricky.lol.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Dead by Daylight! Try `[p]dbd loadout`, `[p]dbd shrine` and `[p]dbd p100`. Drop FModel icon exports in the cog's Icons/ folder and check them with `[p]dbdset assets`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores which characters you've marked as Prestige 100 and your perk wishlist, keyed by your Discord user ID.
